name: Eye of Spartacus

features.name: Expanding multiplier wilds
features.description: The gladiator expands to fill a reel with a 2x–100x multiplier.

features.name: Combined multipliers
features.description: Multiple wilds on one win add their multipliers together.

features.name: Symbol upgrades
features.description: In free spins, each wild adds a spin and upgrades the lowest premium symbol.

review:
A 5x5 gladiator game built around an expanding wild: whenever the Roman warrior lands, he can expand over his reel with a random 2x to 100x multiplier, and several in one win add together.

Three golden lions give 10 free spins, where each expanding wild adds a spin and upgrades every copy of the lowest premium to the next symbol up – so the reels keep getting better. Up to 10,000x, 96.42% RTP. Nice sense of progress.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
